HSK4.hanziSentence: 他的画儿很受大家欢迎。

HSK4.hanziSentence: 李老师的课讲得很有趣。

HSK4.translation: Teacher Li's lecture is very interesting.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 飞机马上就要降落了。

HSK4.translation: The plane will land soon.

HSK4.translation: He looked at his watch, lay down and went to sleep.

HSK4.translation: Today we performed 12 shows in total.

HSK4.translation: Please use these words to say a few sentences.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 春节的时候，家里会来很多客人。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Chūnjié de shíhòu, jiālǐ huì lái hěnduō kèrén
HSK4.translation: During the Spring Festival, there will be many guests at home.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 过生日的时候，我收到了很多礼物。

HSK4.translation: On my birthday, I received many gifts.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个房子差不多有 300 年的历史了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège fángzi chàbùduō yǒu 300 nián de lìshǐle
HSK4.translation: This house is almost 300 years old.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你的普通话说得很好。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ de pǔtōnghuà shuō dé hěn hǎo
HSK4.translation: You speak Mandarin very well.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 人们的生活水平有了很大的提高。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Rénmen de shēnghuó shuǐpíng yǒule hěn dà de tí gāo
HSK4.translation: People's living standards have been greatly improved.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我完全相信你说的话。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ wánquán xiāngxìn nǐ shuō de huà
HSK4.translation: I totally believe what you said.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 像校长这样的人，到哪里都很受欢迎。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Xiàng xiàozhǎng zhèyàng de rén, dào nǎlǐ dōu hěn shòu huānyíng
HSK4.translation: People like the principal are very popular everywhere.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我很小心地抱起了小猫。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ hěn xiǎoxīn dì bào qǐle xiǎo māo
HSK4.translation: I picked up the kitten very carefully.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 校长已经同意了我们的计划。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Xiàozhǎng yǐjīng tóngyìle wǒmen de jìhuà
HSK4.translation: The principal has agreed to our plan.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我会用中文写文章。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ huì yòng zhōngwén xiě wénzhāng
HSK4.translation: I can write articles in Chinese.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个周末你有什么安排？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège zhōumò nǐ yǒu shé me ānpái?
HSK4.translation: What are your plans for this weekend?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请注意安全。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng zhùyì ānquán
HSK4.translation: Please be careful.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè zhǒng gǎnmào yào duì wǒ méi shénme zuòyòng
HSK4.translation: This cold medicine has no effect on me.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这是一个感人的爱情故事。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè shì yīgè gǎnrén de àiqíng gùshì
HSK4.translation: This is a touching love story.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Xiàwǔ de huìyì, wǒ yǐjīng ānpái hǎole
HSK4.translation: I have arranged the meeting for the afternoon.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他的安排让大家都很满意。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā de ānpái ràng dàjiā dōu hěn mǎnyì
HSK4.translation: His arrangement satisfied everyone.

HSK4.translation: Pay attention to safety when driving at night.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请放心，我们会保证您的安全。

HSK4.translation: Please rest assured, we will guarantee your safety.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我按时完成了任务。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ àn shí wánchéngle rènwù
HSK4.translation: I completed the task on time.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Rènwù wánchéng bǎi fēn zhī bāshíle

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你的字写得真棒！
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ de zì xiě dé zhēn bàng!
HSK4.translation: Your handwriting is awesome!

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这家饭馆儿的包子味道非常好。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè jiā fànguǎn er de bāozi wèidào fēicháng hǎo
HSK4.translation: The buns in this restaurant taste very good.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 人们应该保护环境。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Rénmen yīnggāi bǎohù huánjìng
HSK4.translation: People should protect the environment.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我保证，以后不迟到了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ bǎozhèng, yǐhòu bù chídàole
HSK4.translation: I promise you will not be late in the future.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 努力是取得成功的保证。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǔlì shì qǔdé chénggōng de bǎozhèng
HSK4.translation: Effort is the guarantee of success.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ xiǎng bàomíng cānjiā yùndònghuì ma?

HSK4.translation: You are not stupid, you just need to work harder.

HSK4.translation: He expressed his willingness to continue working in the company.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jīntiān de biǎoyǎn tài jīngcǎile!

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā bǎ shìqíng chóngxīn shuōle yībiàn
HSK4.translation: He repeated the matter.

HSK4.translation: Sorry, smoking is not allowed in the hospital.

HSK4.translation: Dad has been on a business trip for more than a month.

HSK4.translation: Please send me a fax.

HSK4.translation: She sits by the window and reads quietly.

HSK4.translation: I have never seen him.

HSK4.translation: You are so careless.

HSK4.translation: Thank you for pointing out my mistake.

HSK4.translation: I don't know the answer to this question.

HSK4.translation: She simply dressed up and went out.

HSK4.translation: These materials have been printed.

HSK4.translation: He greeted me with a smile.

HSK4.translation: He probably won't come.

HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng zài yuánlái de jīchǔ shàng zài gǎi yī gǎi
HSK4.translation: Please make a change on the original basis.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我学习了一些基础的语法知识。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ xuéxíle yīxiē jīchǔ de yǔfǎ zhīshì
HSK4.translation: I learned some basic grammar knowledge.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 看了这部电影，我很激动。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Kànle zhè bù diànyǐng, wǒ hěn jīdòng
HSK4.translation: I was very excited after watching this movie.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个消息真是激动人心。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège xiāoxī zhēnshi jīdòng rénxīn
HSK4.translation: The news is really exciting.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 谢谢你及时赶来帮助我。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Xièxiè nǐ jíshí gǎn lái bāngzhù wǒ
HSK4.translation: Thank you for coming to help me in time.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这场雨下得很及时。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè chǎng yǔ xià dé hěn jíshí
HSK4.translation: The rain fell in time.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 即使遇到了困难也不要放弃。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jíshǐ yù dàole kùnnán yě bùyào fàngqì
HSK4.translation: Don't give up even if you encounter difficulties.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个计划很不错，你就按照它去做吧。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège jìhuà hěn bùcuò, nǐ jiù ànzhào tā qù zuò ba
HSK4.translation: This plan is very good, just follow it.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我们计划在五一节那天结婚。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen jìhuà zài wǔyī jié nèitiān jiéhūn
HSK4.translation: We plan to get married on May Day.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这是一个复杂的技术问题。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè shì yīgè fùzá de jìshù wèntí
HSK4.translation: This is a complex technical issue.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请大家休息一会儿，十分钟后继续上课。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng dàjiā xiūxí yīhuǐ'er, shífēnzhōng hòu jìxù shàngkè
HSK4.translation: Please rest for a while and continue to class in ten minutes.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你的信已经寄到。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ de xìn yǐjīngjì dào
HSK4.translation: Your letter has arrived.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个星期，我们几乎每天都加班。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège xīngqí, wǒmen jīhū měitiān dū jiābān
HSK4.translation: This week, we worked overtime almost every day.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你家附近有加油站吗？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ jiā fùjìn yǒu jiāyóu zhàn ma?
HSK4.translation: Is there a gas station near your home?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 搬家后我们换了新家具。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Bānjiā hòu wǒmen huànle xīn jiājù
HSK4.translation: We changed new furniture after moving.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 从去年开始，汽车的价格在降低。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Cóng qùnián kāishǐ, qìchē de jiàgé zài jiàngdī
HSK4.translation: Since last year, the price of cars has been decreasing.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 做人要诚实，不能说假话。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zuòrén yào chéngshí, bùnéng shuō jiǎ huà
HSK4.translation: Be honest and not tell lies.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他一直坚持自己的看法。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā yīzhí jiānchí zìjǐ de kànfǎ
HSK4.translation: He has always insisted on his opinion.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我每天跑步减肥。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ měitiān pǎobù jiǎnféi
HSK4.translation: I run every day to lose weight.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 顾客减少了三分之一。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Gùkè jiǎnshǎole sān fēn zhī yī
HSK4.translation: Customers have decreased by a third.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我建议明天休息一天。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ jiànyì míngtiān xiūxí yītiān
HSK4.translation: I suggest a day off tomorrow.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他提出了很多有用的建议。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā tíchūle hěnduō yǒuyòng de jiànyì
HSK4.translation: He made a lot of useful suggestions.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 将来你打算做什么工作？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jiānglái nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme gōngzuò?
HSK4.translation: What job do you plan to do in the future?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我们年底发了一笔奖金。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen niándǐ fāle yī bǐ jiǎngjīn
HSK4.translation: We paid out a bonus at the end of the year.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 秋天来了，温度开始降低了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qiūtiān láile, wēndù kāishǐ jiàngdīle
HSK4.translation: Autumn is here and the temperature starts to drop.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我已经把材料交给经理了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ cáiliào jiāo gěi jīnglǐle
HSK4.translation: I have handed over the materials to the manager.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我交了很多中国朋友。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒjiāole hěnduō zhōngguó péngyǒu
HSK4.translation: I have made many Chinese friends.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 国家之间的文化交流越来越丰富。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Guójiā zhī jiān de wénhuà jiāoliú yuè lái yuè fēngfù
HSK4.translation: Cultural exchanges between countries are becoming more and more abundant.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 获得了成功也不能太骄傲。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Huòdéle chénggōng yě bùnéng tài jiāo'ào
HSK4.translation: You can't be too proud of success.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 中国人过春节要吃饺子。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhōngguó rénguò chūnjié yào chī jiǎozi
HSK4.translation: Chinese people eat dumplings during the Spring Festival.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他是一位大学教授。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā shì yī wèi dàxué jiàoshòu
HSK4.translation: He is a university professor.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 父母很重视孩子的教育。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Fùmǔ hěn zhòngshì háizi de jiàoyù
HSK4.translation: Parents attach great importance to children's education.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 爸爸经常教育我要做一个诚实的人。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Bàba jīngcháng jiàoyù wǒ yào zuò yīgè chéngshí de rén
HSK4.translation: Dad always teaches me to be an honest person.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你的意见我都接受。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ de yìjiàn wǒ dū jiēshòu
HSK4.translation: I accept all your opinions.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他想了一会儿接着写。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā xiǎngle yīhuǐ'er jiēzhe xiě
HSK4.translation: He thought for a while and then wrote.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我们下午只有一节课。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen xiàwǔ zhǐyǒuyī jié kè
HSK4.translation: We only have one class in the afternoon.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请节约用水。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng jiéyuē yòngshuǐ
HSK4.translation: Please save water.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你看比赛了吗，结果怎么样？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ kàn bǐsàile ma, jiéguǒ zěnme yàng?
HSK4.translation: Did you watch the game and what was the result?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他把原因解释得很清楚。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā bǎ yuányīn jiěshì dé hěn qīngchǔ
HSK4.translation: He explained the reason very clearly.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请允许我对这件事做个解释。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng yǔnxǔ wǒ duì zhè jiàn shì zuò gè jiěshì
HSK4.translation: Allow me to explain this matter.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 尽管我认识他很久了，但是并不了解。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jǐnguǎn wǒ rènshí tā hěnjiǔle, dànshì bìng bùliǎojiě
HSK4.translation: Although I have known him for a long time, I don't understand.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 第一次演出，他很紧张。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Dì yī cì yǎnchū, tā hěn jǐnzhāng
HSK4.translation: He was nervous for the first performance.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 比赛还在进行。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Bǐsài hái zài jìnxíng
HSK4.translation: The game is still going on.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 她是一位著名的京剧演员。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā shì yī wèi zhùmíng de jīngjù yǎnyuán
HSK4.translation: She is a famous Peking opera actor.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 近些年来这个城市的经济发展很快快。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jìn xiē niánlái zhège chéngshì de jīngjì fāzhǎn hěn kuài kuài
HSK4.translation: The economy of this city has developed rapidly in recent years.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这段时间，我经历了很多事情。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè duàn shíjiān, wǒ jīnglìle hěnduō shìqíng
HSK4.translation: During this time, I experienced many things.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我的经历我都写在这本书里了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ de jīnglì wǒ dū xiě zài zhè běn shū lǐle
HSK4.translation: I have written all my experiences in this book.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他在工作中积累了很多经验。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā zài gōngzuò zhōng jīlěile hěnduō jīngyàn
HSK4.translation: He has accumulated a lot of experience in his work.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你们的表演真精彩，大家都很喜欢。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐmen de biǎoyǎn zhēn jīngcǎi, dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuān
HSK4.translation: Your performance was really wonderful, everyone loved it.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 日落的时候，海边的景色很美。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Rìluò de shíhòu, hǎibiān de jǐngsè hěn měi
HSK4.translation: At sunset, the seaside scenery is beautiful.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我从小就想成为一名警察。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng chéngwéi yī míng jǐngchá
HSK4.translation: I have wanted to be a policeman since I was young.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他们竟然只用了一周就完成了任务。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tāmen jìngrán zhǐ yòngle yīzhōu jiù wánchéngle rènwù
HSK4.translation: They actually completed the task in only a week.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 对不起，我把镜子打破了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Duìbùqǐ, wǒ bǎ jìngzi dǎpòle
HSK4.translation: Sorry, I broke the mirror.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你究竟为什么哭呢？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ jiùjìng wèishéme kū ne?
HSK4.translation: Why are you crying?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 大家还有问题吗？请举手。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Dàjiā hái yǒu wèntí ma? Qǐng jǔ shǒu
HSK4.translation: Do you have any questions? Please raise your hand.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个活动由我们来举办。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège huódòng yóu wǒmen lái jǔbàn
HSK4.translation: This event is organized by us.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 会议两点钟举行。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Huìyì liǎng diǎn zhōng jǔxíng
HSK4.translation: The meeting will be held at two o'clock.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他拒绝了大家的邀请。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā jùjuéle dàjiā de yāoqǐng
HSK4.translation: He declined everyone's invitation.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我家距离公司很远。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒjiā jùlí gōngsī hěn yuǎn
HSK4.translation: My home is far away from the company.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 明天有个聚会，你想参加吗？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Míngtiān yǒu gè jùhuì, nǐ xiǎng cānjiā ma?
HSK4.translation: There is a party tomorrow. Do you want to attend?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你是在开玩笑吧？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ shì zài kāiwánxiào ba?
HSK4.translation: Are you kidding me?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 妹妹开心地笑了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Mèimei kāixīn dì xiàole
HSK4.translation: My sister smiled happily.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 请说说您对这件事儿的看法吧。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Qǐng shuō shuō nín duì zhè jiàn shì er de kànfǎ ba
HSK4.translation: Please tell me your opinion on this matter.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我会认真考虑一下这个问题。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ huì rènzhēn kǎolǜ yīxià zhège wèntí
HSK4.translation: I will seriously consider this issue.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他在学校里学习了很多科学知识。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā zài xuéxiào lǐ xuéxíle hěnduō kēxué zhīshì
HSK4.translation: He learned a lot of scientific knowledge in school.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这棵树又高又大。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè kē shù yòu gāo yòu dà
HSK4.translation: The tree is tall and big.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他感冒了，咳嗽得很厉害。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā gǎnmàole, késòu dé hěn lìhài
HSK4.translation: He has a cold and has a bad cough.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个小孩儿找不到家了，真可怜。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège xiǎo hái'ér zhǎo bù dàojiāle, zhēn kělián
HSK4.translation: This child can't find home, it's so pitiful.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 虽然我很想去，可是实在没时间。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Suīrán wǒ hěn xiǎng qù, kěshìshízài méi shíjiān
HSK4.translation: Although I really want to go, I really don't have time.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你不能来参加我们的聚会太可惜了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ bùnéng lái cānjiā wǒmen de jùhuì tài kěxíle
HSK4.translation: It's a pity that you can't come to our party.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 爸爸正在客厅看电视呢。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Bàba zhèngzài kètīng kàn diànshì ne
HSK4.translation: Dad is watching TV in the living room.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我五点以前肯定会回来。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ wǔ diǎn yǐqián kěndìng huì huílái
HSK4.translation: I will definitely be back before five o'clock.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 盒子里是空的，什么都没有。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Hézi lǐ shì kōng de, shénme dōu méiyǒu
HSK4.translation: The box is empty and there is nothing.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 公园里空气非常新鲜。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Gōngyuán lǐ kōngqì fēicháng xīnxiān
HSK4.translation: The air in the park is very fresh.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 恐怕要下雨了，你带伞了吗？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Kǒngpà yào xià yǔle, nǐ dài sǎnle ma?
HSK4.translation: I'm afraid it's going to rain, have you brought an umbrella?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 药太苦了，我不想吃。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Yào tài kǔle, wǒ bùxiǎng chī
HSK4.translation: The medicine is too bitter, I don't want to take it.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我买了两瓶矿泉水。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ mǎile liǎng píng kuàngquán shuǐ
HSK4.translation: I bought two bottles of mineral water.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我困了，要去睡觉。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ kùnle, yào qù shuìjiào
HSK4.translation: I'm sleepy and want to go to bed.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 工作中，我们遇到了很多困难。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Gōngzuò zhōng, wǒmen yù dàole hěnduō kùnnán
HSK4.translation: In our work, we encountered many difficulties.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个任务对我来说很困难。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège rènwù duì wǒ lái shuō hěn kùnnán
HSK4.translation: This task is very difficult for me.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 街上有许多垃圾桶。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Jiē shàng yǒu xǔduō lèsè tǒng
HSK4.translation: There are many trash cans on the street.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 妈妈拉着女儿的手。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Māmā lāzhe nǚ'ér de shǒu
HSK4.translation: Mother took her daughter's hand.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我不习惯吃太辣的菜。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ bù xíguàn chī tài là de cài
HSK4.translation: I am not used to eating too spicy dishes.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我今天早上起晚了，来不及吃早饭了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang qǐ wǎnle, láibují chī zǎofànle
HSK4.translation: I got up late this morning and it was too late for breakfast.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 电影九点半才开始，还来得及。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Diànyǐng jiǔ diǎn bàn cái kāishǐ, hái láidéjí
HSK4.translation: The movie didn't start until half past nine, and it was too late.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他来自一个美丽的海边城市。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Tā láizì yīgè měilì dì hǎibiān chéngshì
HSK4.translation: He comes from a beautiful seaside city.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 我家的小猫很懒，一个下午都在睡觉。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Wǒ jiā de xiǎo māo hěn lǎn, yīgè xiàwǔ dōu zài shuìjiào
HSK4.translation: My cat is very lazy and sleeps all afternoon.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这样做只是浪费时间。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhèyàng zuò zhǐshì làngfèi shíjiān
HSK4.translation: This is just a waste of time.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这本书讲了一个浪漫的爱情故事。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhè běn shū jiǎngle yīgè làngmàn de àiqíng gùshì
HSK4.translation: This book tells a romantic love story.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 每次去动物园，儿子最喜欢看的就是老虎。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Měi cì qù dòngwùyuán, érzi zuì xǐhuān kàn de jiùshì lǎohǔ
HSK4.translation: Every time I go to the zoo, my son’s favorite thing to watch is the tiger.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你别激动，先冷静一下。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ bié jīdòng, xiān lěngjìng yīxià
HSK4.translation: Don't get excited, please calm down.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个礼拜天，你有空吗？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège lǐbài tiān, nǐ yǒu kòng ma?
HSK4.translation: Are you free this Sunday?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个小朋友很有礼貌。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège xiǎopéngyǒu hěn yǒu lǐmào
HSK4.translation: This kid is very polite.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 你什么时候去理发？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Nǐ shénme shíhòu qù lǐfǎ?
HSK4.translation: When do you go for a haircut?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 这个问题你能理解了吗？
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zhège wèntí nǐ néng lǐjiěle ma?
HSK4.translation: Can you understand this question?

HSK4.hanziSentence: 因为努力学习，他获得了理想的成绩。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Yīnwèi nǔlì xuéxí, tā huòdéle lǐxiǎng de chéngjī
HSK4.translation: Because of hard work, he got the desired result.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 走了这么多路，我累得一点儿力气都没有了。
HSK4.pinyinSentence: Zǒule zhème duō lù, wǒ lèi dé yīdiǎn er lìqì dōu méiyǒule
HSK4.translation: After walking so many roads, I was too tired to have any strength at all.

HSK4.hanziSentence: 他病得很厉害，住院了。

HSK5.translation: A: I'm sorry. B: It doesn't matter.

HSK5.translation: Several people came to my house.

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Jiǎ: Duìbùqǐ! Yǐ: Méiguānxì
HSK5.translation: A: I'm sorry! B: It doesn't matter.

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Wǒ bù rènshí nà (nà'er) gèrén
HSK5.translation: I don't know that person (there).

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Nǐmen jiā yǒu jǐ gèrén nà (nà'er)?

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Nǐ rènshí zhège rén ma?

HSK5.translation: The man in front is my classmate.

HSK5.translation: A: Thank you. B: You're welcome!

HSK5.hanziSentence: 这儿一个人都没有。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Zhè'er yīgè rén dōu méiyǒu
HSK5.translation: There is no one here.

HSK5.translation: This person is really tall.

HSK5.translation: Because there are no people in the classroom, it is quiet.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 因为有你帮忙，这件事情处理得很好。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Yīnwèi yǒu nǐ bāngmáng, zhè jiàn shìqíng chǔlǐ dé hěn hǎo
HSK5.translation: Because of your help, this matter was handled very well.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 冬天，北方比南方冷多了。

HSK5.translation: In winter, the north is much colder than the south.

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Fángjiān lǐ de dēng zěnme bù liàngle?
HSK5.translation: Why doesn't the light in the room turn on?

HSK5.hanziSentence: 小王对音乐很感兴趣。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Xiǎo wáng duì yīnyuè hěn gǎn xìngqù

HSK5.translation: I am afraid of going out alone at night.

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Wǒ gǎndòng dé jīhū yào liúlèile
HSK5.translation: I was so moved that I almost shed tears.

HSK5.translation: The daughter's face is round and cute.

HSK5.translation: He applied to teach in this university.

HSK5.translation: Because of his serious work, he has won everyone's trust.

HSK5.pinyinSentence: Yǔyán shì biǎodá sīxiǎng de gōngjù
HSK5.translation: Language is a tool for expressing ideas.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 今年学校的人数从 800增加到了 1000。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Jīnnián xuéxiào de rénshù cóng 800 zēngjiā dàole 1000
HSK5.translation: The number of students in the school has increased from 800 to 1,000 this year.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 事实证明，你是对的。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Shì shí zhèngmíng, nǐ shì duì de
HSK5.translation: It turns out that you are right.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 他指着前面，高兴地说：“你看，小王来了。”
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Tā zhǐzhe qiánmiàn, gāoxìng de shuō: Nǐ kàn, xiǎo wáng láile
HSK5.translation: He pointed to the front and said happily: "Look, Xiao Wang is here."

HSK5.hanziSentence: 学校周围有一大片森林。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Xuéxiào zhōuwéi yǒu yī dàpiàn sēnlín
HSK5.translation: There is a large forest around the school.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 旧社会里，有的有钱人的房子屋顶很高。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Jiù shèhuì lǐ, yǒu de yǒu qián rén de fángzi wūdǐng hěn gāo
HSK5.translation: In the old society, some wealthy people had high roofs.

HSK5.hanziSentence: 客厅正面的墙上，正中挂着父的画像。
HSK5.pinyinSentence: Kètīng zhèngmiàn de qiáng shàng, zhèngzhòng guàzhe fù de huàxiàng
HSK5.translation: On the front wall of the living room, there is a portrait of the father in the middle.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他不时候学生。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā bù shíhòu xuéshēng
HSK6.translation: He is a student from time to time.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 照片要三天才能洗出来。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhàopiàn yào sān tiān cáinéng xǐ chūlái
HSK6.translation: It takes three days for the photos to be developed.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 各位乘客，飞机马上就要起飞了。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Gèwèi chéngkè, fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēile
HSK6.translation: Everyone, the plane will take off soon.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 妹妹的嘴边有一粒米。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Mèimei de zuǐ biān yǒu yī lì mǐ
HSK6.translation: There is a grain of rice beside my sister's mouth.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 公共场所禁止抽烟。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Gōnggòng chǎngsuǒ jìnzhǐ chōuyān
HSK6.translation: Smoking is prohibited in public places.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这种植物我们都没见过。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhè zhòng zhíwù wǒmen dōu méi jiànguò
HSK6.translation: We have never seen this kind of plant.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们要充分利用现有的资源来提高生产效率。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen yào chōngfèn lìyòng xiànyǒu de zīyuán lái tígāo shēngchǎn xiàolǜ.
HSK6.translation: We must fully utilize existing resources to improve production efficiency.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 保护环境不仅是政府的责任，更是每个公民应尽的义务。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Bǎohù huánjìng bùjǐn shì zhèngfǔ de zérèn, gèng shì měi gè gōngmín yīng jìn de yìwù.
HSK6.translation: Protecting the environment is not only the responsibility of the government but also the duty of every citizen.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他在这个领域的贡献是有目共睹的。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā zài zhège lǐngyù de gòngxiàn shì yǒumùgòngdǔ de.
HSK6.translation: His contribution in this field is obvious to all.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这篇论文深刻地揭示了人类心理的复杂性。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhè piān lùnwén shēnkè de jiēshìle rénlèi xīnlǐ de fùzá xìng.
HSK6.translation: This thesis profoundly reveals the complexity of human psychology.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 为了缓解经济危机，政府采取了一系列紧急措施。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wèile huǎnjiě jīngjì wēijī, zhèngfǔ cǎiqǔle yī xìliè jǐnjí cuòshī.
HSK6.translation: To alleviate the economic crisis, the government took a series of emergency measures.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 在这个竞争激烈的社会，我们需要不断提升自我价值。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zài zhège jìngzhēng jīliè de shèhuì, wǒmen xūyào bùduàn tíshēng zìwǒ jiàzhí.
HSK6.translation: In this fiercely competitive society, we need to constantly enhance our self-worth.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 尽管面临重重困难，他依然没有动摇最初的信念。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Jǐnguǎn miànlín chóngchóng kùnnán, tā yīrán méiyǒu dòngyáo zuìchū de xìnniàn.
HSK6.translation: Despite facing numerous difficulties, he still hasn't wavered in his original belief.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 双方在核心技术研发方面达成了长期合作的共识。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Shuāngfāng zài héxīn jìshù yánfā fāngmiàn dáchéngle chángqī hézuò de gòngshí.
HSK6.translation: The two sides reached a consensus on long-term cooperation in core technology research and development.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他的演讲辞藻华丽，但缺乏实质性的内容。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā de yǎnjiǎng cízǎo huálì, dàn quēfá shízhì xìng de nèiróng.
HSK6.translation: His speech was flowery, but it lacked substantial content.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们要学会从失败中汲取教训，避免重蹈覆辙。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen yào xuéhuì cóng shībài zhōng jíqǔ jiàoxùn, bìmiǎn chóngdǎofùzhé.
HSK6.translation: We must learn to draw lessons from failure to avoid repeating the same mistakes.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 面对全球气候变暖的严峻挑战，各国必须携手合作，共同应对。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Miànduì quánqiú qìhòu biànnuǎn de yánjùn tiǎozhàn, gèguó bìxū xiéshǒu hézuò, gòngtóng yìngduì.
HSK6.translation: Facing the severe challenge of global warming, all countries must work together to tackle it.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这种新药的研发成功，标志着我国在生物医学领域取得了重大突破。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhè zhǒng xīnyào de yánfā chénggōng, biāozhìzhe wǒguó zài shēngwù yīxué lǐngyù qǔdéle zhòngdà tūpò.
HSK6.translation: The success of this new drug's development marks a significant breakthrough in our country's biomedical field.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他通过缜密的逻辑推理，揭开了这个谜团的真相。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā tōngguò zhěnmì de luójí tuīlǐ, jiēkāile zhège mítuán de zhēnxiàng.
HSK6.translation: Through careful logical reasoning, he uncovered the truth of this mystery.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 在宏观经济政策的引导下，市场逐渐恢复了活力。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zài hóngguān jīngjì zhèngcè de yǐndǎo xià, shìchǎng zhújiàn huīfùle huólì.
HSK6.translation: Under the guidance of macro-economic policies, the market has gradually regained its vitality.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们要善于从琐碎的日常生活中发现不平凡的美。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen yào shànyú cóng suǒsuì de rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng fāxiàn bù píngfán de měi.
HSK6.translation: We should be good at discovering extraordinary beauty from the trivialities of daily life.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 人工智能的普及引发了关于伦理和隐私的广泛讨论。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Réngòng zhìnéng de pǔjí yǐnfāle guānyú lúnlǐ hé yǐnsī de guǎngfàn tǎolù.
HSK6.translation: The popularization of artificial intelligence has sparked widespread discussions about ethics and privacy.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 政府正致力于通过体制改革来消除腐败的根源。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhèngfǔ zhèng zhìlì yú tōngguò tǐzhì gǎigé lái xiāochú fǔbài de gēnyuán.
HSK6.translation: The government is committed to eliminating the root causes of corruption through institutional reform.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这件艺术品巧妙地融合了古典与现代的设计元素。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhè jiàn yìshùpǐn qiǎomiào de rónghéle gǔdiǎn yǔ xiàndài de shèjì yuánsù.
HSK6.translation: This artwork skillfully blends classical and modern design elements.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们要摒弃陈旧的观念，以开放的心态迎接未来的挑战。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen yào bìngqì chénjiù de guānniàn, yǐ kāifàng de xīntài yíngjiē wèilái de tiǎozhàn.
HSK6.translation: We must discard outdated concepts and embrace future challenges with an open mind.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 长期的精神压力会对身体健康产生消极的影响。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Chángqī de jīngshén yālì huì duì shēntǐ jiànkāng chǎnshēng xiāojí de yǐngxiǎng.
HSK6.translation: Long-term mental stress will have a negative impact on physical health.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 双方在谈判中互不相让，导致协议的签署陷入僵局。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Shuāngfāng zài tànpàn zhōng hù bù xiāngràng, dǎozhì xiéyì de qiānshǔ xiànrù jiāngjú.
HSK6.translation: Neither side would yield in the negotiations, leading the signing of the agreement into a deadlock.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他那幽默风趣的演说风格深受观众的青睐。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā nà yōumò fēngqù de yǎnshuō fēnggé shēn shòu guānzhòng de qīnglài.
HSK6.translation: His humorous and witty speaking style is highly favored by the audience.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们必须正视现存的弊端，并寻求有效的解决方案。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen bìxū zhèngshì xiàncún de bìduān, bìng xúnqiú yǒuxiào de jiějué fāng'àn.
HSK6.translation: We must face the existing shortcomings and seek effective solutions.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 尽管这只是个初步的构想，但却具有巨大的商业潜力。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Jǐnguǎn zhè zhǐshì gè chūbù de gòuxiǎng, dàn què jùyǒu jùdà de shāngyè qiánlì.
HSK6.translation: Although this is only a preliminary concept, it has huge commercial potential.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 他凭借卓越的领导才能，带领团队走出了困境。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tā píngjiè zhuóyuè de lǐngdǎo cáinéng, dàilǐng tuánduì zǒuchūle kùnjìng.
HSK6.translation: With his outstanding leadership skills, he led the team out of the predicament.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 教育的核心在于启发学生的创造力和独立思考能力。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Jiàoyù de héxīn zàiyú qǐfā xuéshēng de chuàngzàolì hé dúlì sīkǎo nénglì.
HSK6.translation: The core of education lies in inspiring students' creativity and independent thinking skills.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这个城市的交通设施正在不断完善，为市民提供便利。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhège chéngshì de jiāotōng shèshī zhèngzài bùduàn wánshàn, wèi shìmín tígōng biànlì.
HSK6.translation: The city's transportation facilities are constantly being improved to provide convenience for citizens.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 我们在做决策时，必须考虑到长远的发展利益。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Wǒmen zài zuò juécè shí, bìxū kǎolǜ dào chángyuǎn de fāzhǎn lìyì.
HSK6.translation: When making decisions, we must take long-term development interests into account.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 这种传统的工艺正面临失传的危险，急需得到保护和传承。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Zhè zhǒng chuántǒng de gōngyì zhèng miànlín shīchuán de wēixiǎn, jíxū dédào bǎohù hé chuánchéng.
HSK6.translation: This traditional craft is facing the danger of extinction and urgently needs protection and inheritance.

HSK6.hanziSentence: 通过不断的实践，他积累了丰富的行业经验和人脉资源。
HSK6.pinyinSentence: Tōngguò bùduàn de shíjiàn, tā jīlěile fēngfù de hángyè jīngyàn hé rénmài zīyuán.
HSK6.translation: Through continuous practice, he has accumulated rich industry experience and networking resources.
